name: Universal Intermodal Services - Compton/Rancho Dominguez Terminal - Rancho Dominguez CA

fieldNotes.siteResolution: Universal Intermodal Services / Southern Counties Express Inc dba Universal Intermodal Services, Rancho Dominguez CA terminal at 18020 S Santa Fe Ave, Rancho Dominguez CA 90221 - confirmed via loadmatch.com directory and FMCSA. A drayage / container-yard terminal serving the LA/Long Beach ports in the dense Rancho Dominguez industrial district. Roster geocode moved 149 m; the fenced building-plus-yard property fronting S Santa Fe Ave is the audit target. Center locked at 33.86810,-118.21210.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The whole property is ringed by chain-link perimeter fence. Street View of the S Santa Fe Ave frontage shows fenced front yards with sliding gates set in the fence line at the driveway openings - controlled truck access. Universal Intermodal markets itself as a C-TPAT certified secure carrier, consistent with access control. truckGate = true (flagged uncertain - sliding gates seen but the gate lane was not captured open / in use in Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear staffed guard booth observed beside the gate in Street View. Classed guardShack = false / remoteGs = true (sliding gate without a visible manned booth implies kiosk or driver check-in). Both flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drayageYard: The property is a working drayage yard: rows of chassis and containers along the W and S of the building, trailer/container storage on the N, and equipment lanes - heavy drop-yard character. dropArea 50+, dropYard = true.
fieldNotes.docks: The central warehouse building has a modest dock bank (~18 doors estimated) - this is primarily a yard operation, not a dock-heavy DC. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gates open directly onto S Santa Fe Ave, a busy industrial arterial with little stacking room outside the fence - a truck queue at the gate would spill onto the road. backupSensitive = true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One main warehouse plus a small ancillary building/structure on the parcel - counted as 2. Not a multi-large-building campus, so multipleFacilities = false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through the broader district nearby but no rail spur enters this fenced parcel - drayage moves are by truck. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rancho Dominguez sits inside the dense LA-metro industrial fabric near the ports. Classified Urban.
fieldNotes.imageryNote: The dense, irregular industrial parcel and the ~149 m geocode shift make the exact perimeter and truck-gate count approximate; flagged for human review.
